comparator.name: International Bachelor in Psychology
comparator.sourceNotes: The current official programme is a three-year, 180-EC psychology bachelor with a broad common foundation in behaviour, brain, development, mental health, methods, statistics and professional skills. Students later specialise in Brain and Cognition, Clinical Psychology, Education and Development, or Work and Organisational Psychology, complete minor/exchange and elective space, and finish with a thesis. Brain and Cognition is selected neutrally as the broadest basic-science continuation of the common core.

alternativeSelection.assessment: The closest curriculum combines mind, brain, behaviour, lifespan development and research, and also incorporates the Education and Development interest within a broad psychology pathway. Clinical Psychology and Work and Organisational Psychology remain coherent, feasible and materially distinct official specialisation directions. Three alternatives are included, the maximum.

Matched explicitly after semantic review: Statistics, psychometrics, ethics and scientific communication corresponds to Research Methods & Statistics.
Matched explicitly after semantic review: Brain and Cognition specialisation entry corresponds to Higher Order Functions.
Matched explicitly after semantic review: Personality, biological, developmental, mental-health and cross-cultural psychology corresponds to Introduction to Brain & Behavior.
Matched explicitly after semantic review: Methods, statistics, psychodiagnostics and professional skills corresponds to Statistics & Experimental Methods.
Matched explicitly after semantic review: Cognition, learning, mental health and applied psychology corresponds to Abnormal Psychology.
